digest.component_or_area: LLM agent tool execution and step limits
propositions: Bedrock Converse and Anthropic reject requests with toolUse/toolResult history but missing toolConfig, causing 400 ValidationException when pydantic-ai filters tool definitions after tool calls occur
Current tool_step_limit mechanism hides tools via empty filter, violating provider protocol when convergence boundary trips after first tool invocation, converting valid runs into provider errors
Bounded recovery with tool_step_limit=16 dies with same 400 if evidence runs reach step 17, cascading failure through completion_recovery
Steering wrapper mechanism replaces tool hiding with synthetic steering results, keeping tool definitions advertised throughout run while preventing execution past limit
Steering is advisory; existing UsageLimits budget (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) provides terminal backstop for non-cooperative models
